_comment: Structured, editable AI shopper persona library. This drives BOTH the agent's navigation policy (where it walks, how long it stays) and its gaze weighting (which zones it's biased to look at) - the 'differentiator' piece of the challenge. Add/edit personas here (or via POST /api/personas) without touching code. zone/category keys must match backend/data/store_layout.json.

personas.label: Mission Shopper
personas.description: Knows exactly what they came for. Walks directly to their target product(s), grabs it, and heads to checkout. Rarely distracted by anything off their path.

personas.label: Browser
personas.description: No fixed agenda. Wanders the whole store, glances at most shelves and signage, easily catches ads/promotions, may leave without buying.

personas.label: Brand Loyalist
personas.description: Only interested in one preferred brand. Walks straight past competitor products and promotions to find it; largely immune to in-store advertising.

personas.label: Switcher
personas.description: Price- and promotion-driven. Compares several similar products side by side before deciding, lingers at shelves, and is the most likely to notice and act on ads/discounts.
